title: Simulated strain of lensed and unlensed binary black holes at O4 and Einstein Telescope sensitivity for lensed-pair identification (PI-ResNet v3)

creators.name: Huang, Jiaqing
creators.affiliation: Jiangsu Sungo Intelligent Technology Research Center Co., Ltd.

creators.name: Yuan, Yong
creators.affiliation: Institute of Mechanics, Chinese Academy of Sciences

description:
Strain catalogues of the v3 analysis of the PI-ResNet study (ApJS manuscript AAS82367). Populations drawn with ler 1.0.2 (GWTC-3 power-law-plus-peak binary black holes, merger rate to z = 10, elliptical power-law galaxy lenses with external shear; detection: two images at observed network S/N 8). Waveforms IMRPhenomXPHM, injected into every detector of each configuration: ET = three ET-D interferometers from 5 Hz; O4 = H1, L1 (O4 high) and V1 (AdV) from 20 Hz.

Each event is stored as two whitened streams aligned on the geocentric merger time: stream A (2048 Hz, 4608 samples around a 2 s window) and stream B (below 64 Hz, 128 Hz, 8224 samples around a 64 s window), as float16 noiseless signals (sig_*) for every event; evaluation catalogues (0228) also store the fixed noisy inputs (data_*). Per-event parameters, lens parameters, image types, magnifications, delays and S/N are in pair_meta.csv / event_meta.csv; generation settings in the generation_meta JSON files. Development catalogues are SIS_data_0222 (lensed; the SIS label holds the galaxy-lens family) and Unlensed_data_0222; evaluation catalogues are the 0228 sets. v3_ET2_SIS_data_0228 is the corrected ET evaluation catalogue (image 1 at its own arrival time) used for the reported ET results; v3_ET_SIS_data_0228 is the first build, reported as a sensitivity check. v3_ET_PM_data_0228 is the point-mass robustness set. Each .tar unpacks to one directory of .npy and .csv files; SHA256SUMS lists the tar checksums.

Code and trained networks: the companion software record, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24049483 (concept doi:10.5281/zenodo.21311077).
